text_block_list.text: —It happened right after returning to Japan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...This doesn't feel like us, does it?
Taking a break from plotting our strategies.
choice_data_list: I'll keep up the training right until race day.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I know. You mean 'late-stage burst,' right?
If we're going to hone that—

text_block_list.name: Satono Butler
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting, Young Mistress, Trainer.
The car is waiting on the first floor.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Our ride is here.
Let's continue this conversation when we arrive.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: At the same time as the "first negotiation of the new year," that is.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Duramente's Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Satono Crown-san.
Happy New Year.
—Dura, it's your friend.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...In three more days, we probably would've seen each other in the room.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, my apologies.
I just wanted to begin our negotiations as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—I heard your injury has fully healed.
Word on the street is that your next target race is set as well.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Cut the small talk.
What's the main point?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...OK!
I have come today to request
'intensive training.'"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Intensive training?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Without involving other Umamusume,
I want to set aside a period where it's just the two of us running.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"To pit my legs against the strongest final burst
and perfect my own 'weapon.'"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Of course we've prepared benefits for you participating as well.
Right, Trainer?

I receive a cue from Satono Crown.
To sway the other party's heart in this negotiation—
choice_data_list: I've also prepared a menu that's perfect for coming back after an injury.
Crown has experienced the world stage once before
I've also prepared data that'll be useful for your next race
I've also got data prepared that'll help you in your next race

text_block_list.text:
I receive a cue from Satono Crown.
To sway the other party's heart in this negotiation—
choice_data_list: I've also prepared a menu that's perfect for coming back after an injury.
Crown has experienced the world stage once before
I've also prepared data that'll be useful for your next race
I've also got data prepared that'll help you in your next race

text_block_list.text:
For Duramente, who's just returning from an injury,
the greatest concern is a relapse.

"In that case, we should ensure the medical staff is fully prepared
and lay the groundwork so she doesn't overdo it in training...!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: There is no need for you to worry about me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Just accept it gracefully, please.

Since Duramente is aiming to be number one in the world,
this phrase should strike a chord with her...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, Crown.
You went to Hong Kong over the New Year's break, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes. Did you feel lonely?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Don't change the subject.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Crown.
Were you able to adapt to Hong Kong's turf?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes.
Without any problems.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
Then, once again."

Sincerity. That's all I have.
I'll make the request prepared to offer everything I can—my skills, my time, whatever price is asked.

If I recall correctly, Duramente's next race
should be the Nakayama Kinen.
In that case, I should gather data for it...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
How do you know the details of my next race?
My entry into the Nakayama Kinen wasn't scheduled to be announced until after the new year.
choice_data_list: Huh. If you look into it, you can predict it to some extent...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Crown.
Your Trainer is terrifying.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "...Even without offering such negotiations, if it were your proposal, I would have accepted it."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: If you say it is necessary.
